commands.name: health-sweep
commands.description: Ping SwanStudios API health endpoints + Render deploy status; report green/amber/red

commands.name: queue-list
commands.description: List open approval-queue entries with tier + expiry

commands.name: receipt-digest
commands.description: Render the daily receipt digest (see `./audit-receipts.md` §5)

commands.name: fable-context-compression-estimate
commands.receipt: estimate report path or JSON hash
commands.description: Estimate whether safe local files are cheaper as semantically compressed or image-rendered Fable context; does not render images or call a model

commands.name: wiki-search
commands.description: Search the Obsidian/Karpathy vault, return note titles + snippets

commands.name: stale-client-report
commands.description: Read-only report: clients with no logged session in N days (IDs only, per rule 8)

commands.name: switch-status
commands.description: Read every kill switch's current state

commands.name: verify-chain
commands.description: Verify the tamper-evident hash chain of a day's receipt + queue streams and report any break (E2 spine)

commands.name: verify-until-dry
commands.inputs: none (fixed repo root + committed verification contract)
commands.receipt: verifier receipt path + HEAD + source/scope hashes + verdict
commands.description: Run the canonical Code Perfectionist gates against the current repo change set; report the evidence-bound verdict without dispatching or importing a paid model review

commands.name: hermes-doctor
commands.receipt: per-check ok/fault + exit code (0 healthy/1 degraded/2 fault)
commands.description: Self-diagnosis: lanes + index law, switches readable, chain integrity, clock regression, schedule, receipt roundtrip; the health-panel + runner-preflight data source (E4)

commands.name: brain-view
commands.description: Render the GRAPHICAL command center: the ARMS/Four-C second-brain graph (applications, routines, memory, skills) around the Hermes core, live-lit from local stores, with thought-stream + vitals HUD + ranked next-best-action. HTML/SVG + an HTML label overlay + VIEW-ONLY inlined client JS (zoom/pan/focus/keyboard; the only buttons are zoom/reset view controls). Zero network, zero action/command surface, no broker path - the page grants nothing (F-2/SB-2; redesign v2 Slice 1-2)

commands.name: status-page
commands.description: Render the read-only command-center v0: one static HTML page (switch posture, open queue, anchor level, today's receipts, briefing pointer) from local stores — slice-3 v0, zero buttons, no broker path

commands.name: qa-session-start
commands.description: Open a supervised Browser Harness QA session (Sean authenticates; harness observes — read-only; ANY interaction beyond navigate/scroll/read/capture needs per-run human approval, bridge §6)

commands.name: morning-briefing
commands.description: Generate the daily operator briefing (health, receipts digest, queue, stale clients, calendar placeholder) as a DRAFT doc

commands.name: draft-client-followup
commands.description: Draft (never send) a follow-up message for one stale client ID via the Swan Coach proposal path

commands.name: propose-command
commands.description: Draft a new registry row for an unregistered command Sean requested

commands.name: memory-note
commands.description: Append a note to Hermes working memory (never product data)

commands.name: queue-approve
commands.description: Move a queue entry to approved — **the approval itself; Sean-only channels** (see `./approval-gates.md` §3)

commands.name: queue-deny
commands.description: Deny/expire a queue entry with reason

commands.name: switch-flip
commands.description: Flip a named kill switch (pause/resume an automation)

commands.name: receipt-prune
commands.description: Compress runs/-lane files older than the 90-day hot window into runs/archive (gzip, verified roundtrip, moved never deleted — open-questions Q4 DECIDED)

commands.name: vault-init
commands.description: One-time/idempotent vault runs/-lane scaffolding (index.md law) + switches-file seed if absent (all on)

commands.name: discord-alert
commands.description: Post one templated alert to the ops Discord channel (template ids TBD — `./open-questions.md` Q2)

commands.name: manual-maintenance
commands.inputs: `act description + exact command text recorded + rollback pointer (required to arm)`
commands.receipt: outcome + rollback pointer filed against the armed entry id
commands.description: Reserved intent-class row: records queue + arm authorization for a Sean-run maintenance act (seeder run, migration, credential rotation). The broker queues, arms (cross-channel, `./approval-gates.md` §5), and receipts — execution is Sean at the keyboard, never a command

denied.name: raw-shell
denied.why: Bridge boundary 5. The row exists so a request for shell gets a documented refusal receipt, not a "command not found" that tempts someone to add it

denied.name: direct-sql
denied.why: Bridge boundary 7. All writes travel through SwanStudios APIs; a T4 maintenance exception is a Sean-run manual act recorded through the `manual-maintenance` intent row above — never an executable command

denied.name: env-read
denied.why: Rule 59 read-time secret exposure. No command may return env/secret values through any channel

denied.name: mass-client-message
denied.why: Registry §12 manual-only; per-send approval until trust earned. Blanket messaging is exactly the failure mode approval gates exist to prevent

denied.name: unreviewed-model-proxy
denied.why: A base-URL/request proxy can see prompts, tool schemas, history, API keys, and outputs. It may be proposed only after the source/sandbox/network gates in `../references/FABLE-CONTEXT-COMPRESSION-PROTOCOL.md` pass

switches.name: SWITCH_MASTER
switches.stops: Every registered command except `switch-status` and `switch-flip` itself — the whole broker
switches.flip: Panel big-red · `KILL MASTER` · or Hermes daemon stop

switches.name: SWITCH_HEADLESS_RUNNER
switches.stops: All scheduled/triggered runs; the runner idles (checks this before *each* run — `./headless-runner-spec.md` §3)

switches.name: SWITCH_TELEGRAM_BROKER
switches.stops: Inbound Telegram command processing (bot may still answer "broker paused")
switches.flip: Panel · daemon config · or Telegram bot stop

switches.name: SWITCH_DISCORD_BROKER
switches.stops: All outbound Discord alerts, approved or not

switches.name: SWITCH_BROWSER_HARNESS
switches.stops: Harness session starts (running sessions end at next navigation)

switches.name: SWITCH_RECEIPT_DIGEST
switches.stops: Digest rendering (receipts still *write* — only the view pauses; receipt writing has no switch by design, it is the one thing that must never be off)
